title: You Think You Only Saw Four Letters, Yet One Beep Proves Nine Were Still Glowing
description:
You think your eyes miss details that flash away fast! Yet your brain briefly holds twice what you can say! This is the true story of George Sperling's memory experiment. Here is what went wrong with old vision tests.
